paper.title_en: Monodromy, Hidden Conformal Symmetry and Soft Hair in Kerr-MOG Black Hole
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the two-dimensional conformal field theory (2D CFT) dual of the four-dimensional Kerr-MOG (Kerr-modified gravity) black hole using three complementary approaches: (i) black hole thermodynamics, (ii) monodromy analysis, and (iii) the soft-hair formalism. From these independent methods, we derive consistent expressions for the left- and right-moving temperatures and the central charge of the dual CFT. Finally, we derive the entropy product using these approaches. We show that the product is not universal as well as not quantized. We further explore the hidden conformal symmetry of the non-extremal Kerr-MOG black hole by analyzing the near-region dynamics of a massless scalar field. The resulting Kerr-MOG/CFT correspondence identifies the near-region geometry with a two-dimensional CFT characterized by the temperatures ($T_{L}, T_{R}$) derived in Sec. 3. Moreover, using the Cardy formula, we reproduce the microscopic entropy of the dual CFT and find exact agreement with the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy of the Kerr-MOG black hole. We also show that the low-frequency scalar absorption cross section~(greybody factor) in the near-region Kerr-MOG geometry precisely matches the finite-temperature absorption cross section of the dual 2D CFT. In addition, the near-region scalar wave equation exhibits a hidden $(SL(2,\mathbb{R})_L \times SL(2,\mathbb{R})_R)$ conformal symmetry. These independent results provide strong evidence for the existence of a Kerr/CFT-type holographic duality for the Kerr-MOG black hole, establishing a consistent correspondence between the four-dimensional Kerr-MOG spacetime and a two-dimensional conformal field theory. Furthermore, the hidden conformal symmetry is realized in the form of $\rm {Vir_L} \otimes \rm{ Vir_R}$ diffeomorphisms which act non-trivially on the black hole horizon.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文通过多种方法（热力学、monodromy分析、软毛形式）系统研究了Kerr-MOG黑洞的隐藏共形对称性和全息对偶，提供了强有力的证据。
decision.title_zh: Kerr-MOG黑洞的单值性、隐藏共形对称性与软毛
decision.abstract_zh: 我们使用三种互补方法研究了四维Kerr-MOG（Kerr修正引力）黑洞的双二维共形场论（2D CFT）对偶：（i）黑洞热力学，（ii）单值性分析，以及（iii）软毛形式。从这些独立方法中，我们推导出左行和右行温度以及对偶CFT的中心荷的一致表达式。最后，我们使用这些方法推导了熵乘积。我们证明该乘积既非普适也非量子化。我们进一步通过分析无质量标量场的近区域动力学，探索了非极端Kerr-MOG黑洞的隐藏共形对称性。由此产生的Kerr-MOG/CFT对应将近区域几何识别为一个双二维CFT，其特征温度为第3节中推导的（T_L, T_R）。此外，使用Cardy公式，我们重现了对偶CFT的微观熵，并发现与Kerr-MOG黑洞的贝肯斯坦-霍金熵精确一致。我们还证明了近区域Kerr-MOG几何中的低频标量吸收截面（灰体因子）与对偶二维CFT的有限温度吸收截面精确匹配。此外，近区域标量波动方程展现出隐藏的(SL(2,R)_L × SL(2,R)_R)共形对称性。这些独立结果为Kerr-MOG黑洞存在Kerr/CFT型全息对偶提供了强有力的证据，建立了四维Kerr-MOG时空与二维共形场论之间的一致对应。此外，隐藏共形对称性以Vir_L ⊗ Vir_R微分同胚的形式实现，这些微分同胚非平凡地作用于黑洞视界。
